scope: Disposable local PostgreSQL, repository migrations; hosted state not inspected. After reproducing the clean-install failure, a test-only notification_log.created_by column lets the remaining migrations and checks run.

findings.finding: Migration 004 fails on a clean install: notification_log has no created_by column required by its UPDATE policy
findings.evidence:
ERROR:  column "created_by" does not exist

findings.finding: Employee cannot complete a task assigned by a manager; the update silently affects zero rows
Direct employee requests bypass restock manager approval, including forged approval fields
Operations SELECT policies allow cross-store reads and anonymous reads when Data API SELECT grants exist
Saving audit answers fails because its updated_at trigger targets a missing column
findings.evidence:
ERROR:  record "new" has no field "updated_at"
CONTEXT:  PL/pgSQL assignment "NEW.updated_at = NOW()"
PL/pgSQL function update_updated_at_column() line 3 at assignment

findings.finding: Employees can create and finalize audits through direct data requests without manager permission or score bounds
Checklist completion is accepted with unchecked required work and no photo
Concurrent starts can create duplicate daily checklists; no uniqueness constraint enforces one per day/type
Legacy operations notifications remain readable by other employees after all migrations
Operations migrations do not publish task, inspection, or checklist changes to Realtime
UTC checklist date differs from the store business date before 05:30 IST
